app.title: cambio Tarif-Check
app.subtitle: Find out which cambio tariff would have been the cheapest for your trips.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: A short explanation of what is calculated here, what is left out, and which prices are used.

whatItDoes.title: What this page does
whatItDoes.body: This page compares what your trips actually cost with what they would have cost in the other cambio tariffs. Each trip is priced with the prices that were valid at the time of the trip.
whatItDoes.hindsight: The result is a look back at your past trips. It does not predict which tariff will be the cheapest in future.

data.title: Where the data comes from and where it stays
data.source: The trips come from the export you can download in the cambio customer portal under “Fahrtenarchiv” (trip archive), as CSV or Excel.
data.privacy: Everything is calculated in your browser. Your data is neither uploaded nor stored; once you reload or close the page, it is gone.

trip.title: How a trip is recalculated
trip.intro: Every trip is priced to the minute with the stored prices:
trip.time: Time: each minute costs one sixtieth of the hourly price of the vehicle class in that tariff.
trip.night: Night: from {{nightFrom}} to {{nightTo}} the hour costs {{nightPrice}} in every tariff.
trip.weekend: Weekend: from {{weekendFromDay}} {{weekendFromTime}} until {{weekendToDay}} {{weekendToTime}} the weekend price applies. It exists only in {{weekendTariffs}}; in the other tariffs the hourly price is always the same. Public holidays count like weekends only in some regions, namely in {{holidayCities}}. In all other cities public holidays cost the normal price. The hours from {{nightFrom}} to {{nightTo}} cost the night price on weekends and public holidays too.
trip.caps: Caps: each 24-hour block counted from the start of the booking costs at most the day price, each 7-day block at most the week price. Today the day price is usually the price of {{dayCapHours}} hours and the week price that of {{weekCapDays}} full days; older price lists set fixed day and week prices. A remainder of less than one hour after full days is not charged.
trip.km: Kilometres: the first {{kmBoundary}} km cost the higher price, every further kilometre the cheaper one. A fuel surcharge per kilometre is added, and it changes over time.

earlyReturn.title: Early return and the booked end
earlyReturn.export: The export contains the time of return, not the originally booked end. If you return the car early, cambio charges the unused booked time at 50 %.
earlyReturn.reconstruction: This page works out the booked end from the billed amount: up to the return, rounded up to the next quarter hour, the full price applies, and the rest of the booking costs 50 %. The same booking is then priced in the other tariffs.
earlyReturn.late: If you return the car after the booked end, every minute after it costs double the time price. The page recognises this from the billed amount and prices the same delay in the other tariffs too.
earlyReturn.ambiguous: If several booked ends fit the amount, the earliest is used; if none fits, the trip is priced up to the return. In both cases you can enter the booked end yourself in the trip list.

kinds.title: What the classifications mean
kinds.intro: Every trip gets a classification that shows how reliable its recalculation is:
kinds.rounding: How exactly cambio rounds is not known. A difference of one cent in the time amount is therefore treated as matching and only marked “1 cent rounding”.

months.title: The monthly comparison
months.month: A trip counts in the month in which it was returned. Each month includes the monthly fee of the tariff and, with additional drivers, their fee.
months.actual: Actual cost is the billed amounts plus fees plus {{switchingFee}} per tariff change. Months without trips take the previous month’s tariff unless you correct it in the table.
months.path: The “optimal path” is hindsight: for each month it picks the tariff that makes the total, including switching fees, the smallest. You do not know the month in advance.

limits.title: What is not included
limits.lateFees: flat late fees (“Verspätungsgebühr”) that cambio charges when a late return affects a following booking
limits.credit: trip credits (“Fahrtguthaben”) that cambio offsets against trip costs – they do not depend on the tariff
limits.before: trips before {{date}}: no prices are stored for the time before, so the import sets such trips aside and they are not evaluated
limits.holidays: Public holidays follow a fixed list that may differ from cambio’s calendar. The regional rule comes from cambio’s price calculator and is confirmed by an invoice only for Aachen.
limits.cap: The unused booked time is charged at half the price of exactly those hours, as a span of its own from the return with its own day cap; this is how the invoices show it. That it counts in full at 50 % even when used and unused time together would exceed the day cap is an assumption.

prices.title: Price list
prices.outdated: Prices can change, and this page only knows the date given. Check the current prices with cambio before you switch.
prices.holidayCities: Public holidays at the weekend price in: {{cities}}
prices.vat: All amounts are in euros and include VAT. Kilometre prices are without the fuel surcharge.

classes.title: Prices per tariff and vehicle class
classes.note: The day cap is {{dayCapHours}} × the hourly price and the week cap {{weekCapDays}} × {{dayCapHours}} × the hourly price, except where the price list has its own day or week price; the table always shows the caps used in the calculation. “as hour” means there is no separate weekend price.

disclaimer.title: Not an official offer
disclaimer.body: This page is an independent, unofficial tool and is not affiliated with cambio. There is no guarantee that the results are correct.

where.title: Where do I get the export?
where.text: You can find the export in the cambio customer portal under “Fahrtenarchiv” (trip archive). Pick the period you want there and download the table as CSV or Excel.

import.completeness: The analysis is only correct if the export contains all trips of the period – including those of any additional drivers.

warnings.surcharge_other: For {{count, number}} trips, the fuel surcharge was derived from the billed distance amount.
warnings.mixed: In {{months}}, trips were billed in more than one tariff. Your tariff is taken from the month's last trip.

warnings.incomplete: There are trips in {{months}} that are not billed yet. They are left out of the analysis.
warnings.afterPrices_one: {{count, number}} trip is after the price date ({{date}}) and was priced with the latest known prices.

breakEven.title: When does which tariff pay off?
breakEven.intro: From these monthly trip costs on, the pricier tariff makes up for its higher monthly fee through lower prices – based on your trips.
breakEven.pays: {{higher}} pays off compared with {{lower}} from {{amount}} of trip cost per month (at {{lower}} prices).
breakEven.never: {{higher}} never pays off compared with {{lower}} for your trips: its prices are not low enough to make up for the fee.
breakEven.months: {{count, number}} of {{total, number}} months were above

trips.intro: By month, newest first. For every trip: what was billed and what it would have cost in each tariff.
trips.overrunInferred: booked until {{time}}, probably returned {{minutes}} min later
trips.deviationHint: Difference between the recomputed and the billed amount in the trip's tariff

verified.label: recomputed
verified.text: With the stored prices, the trip costs exactly the billed amount, to the cent.

verified-rounding.label: recomputed (1 cent rounding)
verified-rounding.text: The recomputation differs by one cent only – a matter of rounding.

estimated.label: estimated
estimated.text: Several booked ends match the amount; the earliest one is used. If you know the booked end, enter it.

manual.label: added by hand
manual.text: The booked end you entered is used.

cancelled.label: cancelled at short notice (50 %)
cancelled.text: The booking was cancelled at short notice; half of the time price is charged.

unused.label: not started (100 %)
unused.text: The booking was not used; the full time price is charged.

overrun.label: returned late
overrun.text_one: The car was returned {{count, number}} minute after the booked end. This time costs double the time price.
overrun.text_other: The car was returned {{count, number}} minutes after the booked end. This time costs double the time price.
overrun.inferred_one: The amount matches a return {{count, number}} minute after the booked end. The return time is not in the export; it is inferred from the amount.
overrun.inferred_other: The amount matches a return {{count, number}} minutes after the booked end. The return time is not in the export; it is inferred from the amount.
overrun.general: The car was returned after the booked end. This time costs double the time price.

not-reproducible.label: not reproducible
not-reproducible.text: No booked end yields the billed amount. The trip is priced up to the return; enter the booked end if you know it.

bookedEnd.title: Booked end
bookedEnd.description: Until when was the trip booked? The car was returned on {{time}}. If the booked end lies before that, the time after it counts as a late return at double the time price.
bookedEnd.inferred: Booked until {{booked}} · probably returned {{returned}}. The return time is not in the export; it is inferred from the amount. If that is wrong, enter the booked end or compute without a late return.
bookedEnd.tooEarly: The booked end cannot be before {{time}}.
bookedEnd.invalid: This date does not exist. Please choose a valid date.
bookedEnd.tooLate: The booked end can be at most 30 days after the trip start, so {{time}} at the latest.
